dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing from the mid-thorax region toward the visible posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light grey across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-density, low-contrast dark-pixel clusters distributed uniformly across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between the darker mottled clusters and the lighter grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, prominent longitudinal white linear mark located on the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white linear scar approximately aligned with the longitudinal axis on the posterior peduncle region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible dark circular aperture at the anterior end of the dorsal plane.
